ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - RunXCmd Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the RunXCmd tool to execute commands with System or TrustedInstaller accounts

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/account\\=system\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/account\\=ti\\ .*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/exec\\=.*"))
